title: Restaurants
subtitle: All approved restaurants. Suspending freezes new bookings without losing data.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.reason: This restaurant will be hidden from the Mingler App. Please provide a reason:
suspend.minChars: Reason must be at least 10 characters.
suspend.consequence: While suspended, the restaurant is hidden from the Mingler App and all new bookings are paused until you reactivate it.
suspend.activeBookingsWarning: {{count}} upcoming booking(s) will be cancelled and refunded.

deleteReview.title: Delete review?
deleteReview.content: This review will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.

unsuspend.title: Unsuspend {{name}}?
unsuspend.content: {{name}} will be made visible on the Mingler App again.

changeCategory.title: Change Category — {{name}}
changeCategory.subtitle: Select a new category for this restaurant:
changeCategory.warning: Changing the category updates the commission rate for all future bookings at this restaurant. Existing completed bookings are not affected.

amenities.empty: No amenities assigned to this restaurant.
amenities.label: amenity

menu.empty: No menu items have been added yet.

schedule.title: Table Timings
schedule.empty: No tables have been set up yet.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.deleteConfirm: This review will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.

bookings.title: All Bookings
bookings.itemisedBillDisabled: Itemised bill is only available for completed bookings.

cancelModal.title: Cancel booking?
cancelModal.intro: Cancelling will notify {{guest}} via email and an in-app notification. Please provide a reason.
cancelModal.minChars: Reason must be at least 10 characters.

bookings.cancelToast: Booking {{bookingId}} cancelled. {{guest}} has been notified by email.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.noContacts: No contacts have been added yet.

placeholders.scheduleTimingComingSoon: Schedule and timing management coming soon.

access.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
access.notEmailed: Saved, but the email could not be sent. Share the Partner Portal link with them yourself.

add.title: Add a restaurant
add.intro: Create the profile with the restaurant's name and its owner. We email the owner, who signs up with this email (or continues with Google), adds the rest of the details and sends the profile for approval.
add.name: Restaurant name
add.ownerEmailHelp: The owner signs in to the Partner Portal with this email.
add.ownerPhoneInvalid: Enter a valid phone number, or leave it empty.
add.failed: The restaurant could not be created. Please try again.
add.createdNoEmail: {{name}} created, but the email could not be sent. Use Resend, or share the Partner Portal link yourself.

invited.title: Waiting for the owner
invited.hint: Profiles GoMingle created. Each one moves to the Approval Queue when its owner sends it for approval.
invited.cancelBody: The owner will no longer be able to sign in to this profile.
invited.loadFailed: Restaurants waiting for their owner could not be loaded.

logins.title: Partner Portal access
logins.hint: The people who can sign in to this restaurant. A restaurant can have more than one owner.
logins.loadFailed: Could not load who has access.
logins.none: Nobody can sign in to this restaurant. Give an email access so its owner can get in.

grant.title: Give access to {{name}}
grant.intro: The person is emailed and signs up with this email, or continues with Google. An email that only has an empty, unfinished account is moved to this restaurant.

edit.title: Edit {{name}}
edit.emailHint: They sign in with this email. Changing it unlinks Google and emails the new address.
edit.ownerHint: Owners add and manage the restaurant's team on the Partner Portal.
edit.memberHint: Team members can use the portal and see the team, but cannot change who has access.
edit.savedEmailed: Saved. We emailed {{email}} so they can sign in.

remove.title: Remove access for {{name}}?
remove.body: {{email}} will no longer be able to sign in to this restaurant. You can give access again later.

bulk.suspendBody_one: It disappears from the Mingler app and its owners can't take new bookings until it is reactivated. Restaurants with upcoming bookings are skipped and listed below.
bulk.suspendBody_other: They disappear from the Mingler app and their owners can't take new bookings until reactivated. Restaurants with upcoming bookings are skipped and listed below.
bulk.reactivateBody_one: It goes back on the Mingler app and its owners can take bookings again.
bulk.reactivateBody_other: They go back on the Mingler app and their owners can take bookings again.

manage.onBehalf: You're changing this on the restaurant's behalf. The restaurant's own rules apply, and the change is logged in the change log.
manage.loadFailed: This couldn't be loaded. Please try again.
manage.saveFailed: This couldn't be saved. Please try again.
manage.readOnly: This restaurant is waiting for approval, so its details can't be changed right now.

details.title: Edit restaurant details
details.name: Restaurant name
details.mapLinkHint: Paste a Google Maps link and choose Use link to fill in the coordinates.
details.mapLinkInvalid: No coordinates were found in this link.

tables.title: Tables
tables.name: Table area name
tables.hint: Weekly availability stays as the restaurant set it. A table in use by an upcoming interest table can't be removed; hide it instead.

menus.title: Menu options
menus.name: Menu name
menus.optionsPh: Separate dishes with commas, e.g. Biryani, Karahi

amenities.title: Amenities
amenities.empty: No amenities in the catalogue yet. Add them under Amenities.

archive.title: Archive {{name}}?
archive.body: An archived restaurant leaves the Mingler app and the restaurant list, and all its data is kept. You can restore it at any time; it stays hidden from the app until the restaurant turns visibility on again.
archive.reason: Why is it being archived? (at least 10 characters)
